blocks.text: The Philippine Under-17 Women's National Football Team (Filipinas U17) qualified for the AFC U17 Women's Asian Cup for the third consecutive time, sweeping Group H of the 2027 qualifying tournament with a 3-0 win over Bangladesh on Sunday at Do'stlik Stadium Training Pitch 1.
